name: Store plugin (full)
author: LoomWeaver
description: A sandboxed community plugin installed at runtime from the testbed's own catalogue. It adds a tab to the dashboard the moment it is installed and brings its own settings, so the install, settings and uninstall paths are all exercised.

name: Store plugin (minimal)
author: LoomWeaver
description: The smallest possible community plugin: one static dashboard tab, no settings. It is the contrast case that proves a plugin without settings gets no settings entry.
